pap.hero_intro: Wilfrido Ortega (26 Oktober 1932 – 26 Mei 2026) a dediká su mes na skibi i publiká buki na Papiamentu. Su produktividatnan, su forma di imprimí i su distribushon di porta pa porta ta e temanan ku e website aki ta eksplorá.

en.hero_intro: Wilfrido Ortega (26 October 1932 – 26 May 2026) devoted himself to writing and publishing books in Papiamentu. This website explores his works, his printing methods, and his door-to-door distribution.
